message: 追憶へのアプローチ

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, pass the soy sauce」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, isn't this Worcestershire sauce!」

name: Paqy
message: 「They look too damn similar」

name: Synn
message: 「My tuna scrape is ruined...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even the mighty Demon Lord won't call gross food tasty, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Sauce on sashimi is just unthinkable」

name: Paqy
message: 「You can't call scraped tuna ribs sashimi」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahh, though I won't get stronger unless I eat...」

name: Paqy
message: 「You did move around a lot today, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... It's surprisingly good!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooh? Let's see...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah. Sure got tired today~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't make that refreshed face after tricking me!」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope that made me stronger, though... Wonder how it went?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Open the menu and select Status, and it'll be obvious at a glance」

name: Synn
message: 「Honestly Paqy, you play too many games」

name: Paqy
message: 「There are only shitty games anyway!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Since I went through the trouble of becoming the Demon Lord and all. Isn't there some nifty secret where I suddenly power up and get strong or something?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, I think there is, technically」

name: Synn
message: 「Right~~. The world isn't that swee--」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, there actually is one!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah. Never mind that, Lord Synn--pass back the soy sauce」

name: Synn
message: 「'Never mind that'? Isn't this a huge deal?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I knew it--the Demon Lord really does have a hidden power. Once I get my hands on that...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Peace at the academy, scholarships, the entire world, cute girls--every last bit of it will belong to the Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't just casually turn me into a villain」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey! This is Worcestershire sauce, isn't it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, that ultimate secret technique. If it exists, tell me already」

name: Paqy
message: 「Calling it an 'ultimate secret technique'--you're way too influenced by video games, Lord Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「I really want a next-gen console...」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Demon Lord's secret, huh... To tell you the truth, I totally forgot it」

name: Synn
message: 「What... If you forget something that important, you lose your whole reason to exist as a familiar, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Despite how I look, I've lived for so many years this body's practically worn threadbare」

name: Synn
message: 「If your memories wear away too, doesn't that defeat the whole point of transferring yourself into a plushie just to keep living?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well... maybe you've got a point」

name: Synn
message: 「You definitely ought to remember it, if only to leave proof of how hard you've worked, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「You mean you're not blaming me for being so forgetful, Lord Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course not. I figure there's a deep reason why you went out of your way to become a plushie, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「I see... Man, I forgot the reason for that ages ago too...」

name: Synn
message: 「Try your best to remember it」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, I'll trace back through my memories」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. And don't forget the Demon Lord's secret while you're at it」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait... did I just get played...?」
